# thalassa_natgateway_instance_size (Data Source)

Get a NAT gateway instance size by name



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the NAT gateway instance size to look up (for example ng-gp-small)

### Optional

- `organisation_id` (String) Reference to the Organisation. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.

### Read-Only

- `egress_bandwidth_rate` (Number) Egress bandwidth rate of the NAT gateway instance size
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the NAT gateway instance size is enabled
- `id` (String) Identity of the NAT gateway instance size
- `ingress_bandwidth_rate` (Number) Ingress bandwidth rate of the NAT gateway instance size
